codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly fixes the customer sync handler to use the client-provided entity ID. CustomerSyncHandler.handleCreate() now passes operation.entityId to customerRepo.create(), and customerRepo.create() accepts an optional id parameter and uses it when provided. The pattern follows the established approach used in SaleSyncHandler.
